name: Bethor Iceshard
summary: In the Undercity, Bethor Iceshard commands the Magic Quarter's arcane and shadow practitioners. He holds authority in Sylvanas's realm, while old friendships still shape his past.

sections.title: Master of the Magic Quarter
sections.body: Bethor Iceshard directs arcane and shadow practitioners from the Temple of the Damned in the Undercity. His intellect and icy resolve earn both respect and fear. He has the political and magical weight to instruct provincial magistrates across Lordaeron. Bethor sends Forsaken agents to secure valuable grimoires, investigate arcane anomalies, and suppress rival powers that threaten the Undercity's dominion.

sections.title: Old Friends and Bittersweet Reunions
sections.body: Bethor Iceshard still remembers his former companions. He tracks powerful undead spellcasters across Tirisfal and Silverpine, sending agents to learn whether rogue practitioners serve the Lich King or might join the Forsaken cause. When he finds Gunther Arcanus raising the dead at Brightwater Lake, Bethor patiently works to bring his old friend into Lady Sylvanas's fold. Thule Ravenclaw receives no such mercy; his willing betrayal doomed their brotherhood.

sections.title: Bonds of Apprenticehood
sections.body: Before the Third War devastated Lordaeron, Bethor Iceshard studied magic as a mortal apprentice beside his close companions, Gunther Arcanus and Thule Ravenclaw. The three wove their practice wands together to mark their fellowship. The Scourge shattered that bond. As death and dark magic swept the kingdom, Thule willingly gave his soul to the Lich King. Gunther perished and rose again on an isolated island in Brightwater Lake. Bethor succumbed as well, then broke free as Forsaken.

faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard commands arcane and shadow practitioners at the Temple of the Damned in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. He directs magical research, intelligence on rogue practitioners, and covert arcane operations for the Dark Lady.

faq.q: Where can Bethor Iceshard be found?
faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard resides inside the Temple of the Damned, in the Undercity's Magic Quarter.

faq.q: What is Bethor's history with Gunther Arcanus?
faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard and Gunther Arcanus were close friends and fellow apprentice mages in Lordaeron. Both died during the Scourge invasion and later broke free from the Lich King's control. Bethor arranged for Gunther to join the Forsaken.

faq.q: Who was Thule Ravenclaw to Bethor?
faq.answer: Thule Ravenclaw was the third member of Bethor Iceshard and Gunther Arcanus's apprentice circle. During the Scourge invasion, he willingly pledged his soul to the Lich King and became a hated necromancer living at Fenris Isle.

faq.q: What is the story behind Bethor's wand?
faq.answer: As young apprentices, Bethor Iceshard, Gunther Arcanus, and Thule Ravenclaw wove their practice wands together as a sign of eternal friendship. The braided keepsake connects the three fractured spellcasters to their mortal past.

faq.q: What role does Bethor play in Forsaken society?
faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard is one of the Undercity's leading arcane authorities. He guides newly risen magi and warlocks, directs intelligence on rogue necromancers, and holds authority over regional Forsaken civil officials such as magistrate Sevren.

angles.text: As a Forsaken mage, you can see in Bethor Iceshard how the arcane arts endure through undeath.
As an Undead, you may know the pain of losing friends and home to the Scourge, then facing former allies as enemies.
As a member of the Horde, you benefit from Bethor Iceshard's offensive magic and counter-necromancy efforts, which protect the Horde's foothold across Lordaeron.
